# Plumb Perfect of Southern Utah

> Plumber in Hurricane, UT. Owner Tracy handles disposals, water heaters, pipe upgrades and softeners across Southern Utah. Prompt, meticulous, fairly priced, and he cleans up after.

Note: this is a preview site built by Handled (handleditforyou.com), not yet the business's live website.

## Contact
- Phone: (435) 635-4996
- Website: https://handleditforyou.com/demo/plumb-perfect/
- Google rating: 4.8 stars from 20 reviews

## Services
- Garbage disposals: Old disposals out, new ones in, work area cleaned up.
- Water heaters: Water heater repairs that save you a replacement when they can.
- Pipe upgrades & bathrooms: Old steel pipes upgraded and bathroom plumbing redone.
- Softeners & filtration: Water softeners swapped and whole-house filtration installed.

## Service area
- Hurricane

## Questions customers ask
- **Do you replace garbage disposals?** Yes. One customer had Tracy replace a garbage disposal and said he was prompt, meticulous and cleaned up after.
- **Can you save my water heater?** Sometimes. One customer thanked Tracy for saving their hot water heater instead of replacing it.
- **Do you upgrade old pipes?** Yes. A customer had old steel pipes upgraded and their bathroom plumbing redone.
- **Do you install water filtration?** Yes. One customer had an old water softener removed and a whole-house filtration and descaling system installed.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve Hurricane and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
